WorkflowPad manual

Five desktop programs that turn a story, a prompt or a folder of pictures into images through your own ComfyUI. Version 0.1.0 Beta.

ProgramUse it to
Story Generator (WorkflowPad.exe)Write a story, let an AI plan the shots, write the image prompts and render the pictures.
Image Editor (ImageEditor.exe)Open a folder of pictures and edit, extend, enhance or caption them with ComfyUI workflows.
Prompt Lab (PromptLab.exe)Keep a list of prompts, chat with an LLM about them and test them against a workflow.
Batch Editor (BatchEditor.exe)Edit images with one workflow and one prompt.
Gallery Generator (GalleryGenerator.exe)Generate many pictures from a list of prompts and workflows into a folder gallery.

Start here

What you need

  • Windows 11 (the portable build needs no Python).
  • ComfyUI, installed and running on your computer (default address 127.0.0.1:8188). WorkflowPad does not include ComfyUI or any model.
  • Workflows exported from your ComfyUI (Workflow → Export (API)) and placed in the comfy_apis folders. The folder comfy_workflow has examples and its own README.txt that explains this step by step.
  • For Story Generator, an AI to write the story plan: either a Grok API key, or a local LLM workflow running in your ComfyUI (comfy_apis/llm).

First run in four steps

  1. Extract the ZIP to any folder and start WorkflowPad.exe. If Windows shows a SmartScreen warning because the program is not code-signed, choose More info → Run anyway.
  2. Start ComfyUI and keep it running. If it is not on 127.0.0.1:8188, change the address in Settings → Connection (every program has it).
  3. Put your workflows in comfy_apis/image_create (pictures from text), comfy_apis/image_edit (editing a picture), comfy_apis/llm (LLM chat), comfy_apis/caption (image → prompt) and comfy_apis/enhance (face restore, upscale). They appear in the programs' workflow lists; use the small refresh button next to a list to rescan.
  4. Open a program and follow its chapter below.
Tip WorkflowPad reads the workflow files; it never changes them. If a workflow is missing from a list, check that you used Export (API) (not Save) and that the file is in the right folder.

Story Generator

Story Generator takes a story and builds a storyboard: a list of shots, each with narration or dialogue and an image prompt. Then it renders every shot with your ComfyUI workflow. You stay in control: every step can be reviewed, edited and repeated.

Needs ComfyUI / an LLM Planning the story and writing prompts needs an AI (a Grok API key or a local LLM). Rendering needs ComfyUI with an image workflow. Browsing, editing and saving projects work without them.

From story to images

  1. Write or paste your story in the Story box on the left. You can also open the project of an earlier session (Manage Projects).
  2. Choose the AI Model under the story box: [Grok API] or one of your local LLM workflows (the files in comfy_apis/llm). For Grok, enter your key first in Settings → Grok API; without it the program tells you Enter Grok API Key first.
  3. Click Generate Outline. The AI reads the story and plans characters, places and events. The story is not changed.
  4. Review the outline in the Review Outline dialog (also reachable any time with the list button under the storyboard). Tabs along the top let you check and correct the story, characters, locations and more. Use Save Outline to keep your changes, Create shot to design the shots, and Continue to Image Prompts… to go on.
  5. Write the image prompts. The Image Prompts dialog asks how to proceed (see Dialogs). Choose Rebuild all for a fresh set, or Empty only to fill just the shots that have no prompt yet.
  6. Check the result. Every shot card shows its narration, any dialogue and the prompt. Edit a prompt directly in its box, or use the buttons on the card (see the table below). The optional Check Prompts and Direct Prompts buttons ask the AI to look for inconsistencies or to add camera and lighting.
  7. Render. In the Render panel on the right pick an Image Workflow and an Image Size, then click Render All (every shot) or Render Missing (only shots without a picture). Use Test Shot or Preview All first for quick low-step previews; Finalize re-renders previews at full quality with the same seed.
  8. Export. Export Images saves the results of the project.
Tip Everything is saved in your project. Use Save Project (disk icon) often; a project is one file in your stories folder (see Where your data is).

The main screen

The buttons on a shot card

ButtonWhat it does
Image PromptWrites this shot's prompt again.
Chat to edit this promptOpens a small chat where you ask the AI to change the prompt (“make it darker”).
Consistency CheckChecks this shot's prompt for consistency with the story.
Visual DirectionAdds camera and lighting to this shot.
Test ShotQuick preview with fewer steps (the Preview Steps value in the Render panel).
Generate ShotRenders this shot with the selected workflow.

Render panel options

OptionMeaning
Image WorkflowThe ComfyUI workflow used to draw: the files in comfy_apis/image_create (text-to-image). The refresh button rescans the folder.
Inpaint ModeUse the previous frame as a reference instead of drawing from text only. The extra Inpaint/Img2Img Workflow list shows the files in comfy_apis/image_edit; pick one that takes a source picture and does not need a mask, because this mode sends the picture but no mask.
StyleStyle words added to every image prompt. No style specified adds nothing.
Image SizeWidth and height of the pictures, for example 16:9.
Stepsdefault (workflow) keeps the steps stored in your workflow.
Seed LockKeep the same seed for every render so a change in the prompt is the only change.
Scene DescriptionPut the scene description in front of each prompt.
Clear ImagesDeletes every picture of the project from disk after you confirm. This cannot be undone.

Dialogs

Note Raw changes the project data directly. Save replaces everything; Merge applies only the fields you give. Export or copy first if you are unsure.

Settings

Image-to-text workflow chooses the workflow that describes pictures for the vision Check and Direct buttons (any workflow in comfy_apis/caption). Auto picks a JoyCaption workflow, the short one first.

Use the program’s LLM settings decides who sets the sampler values of the LLM calls:

SwitchWhat happens
On (default)The program sets the values it was tested with: for example repeat penalty 1.0 for the Shot List and Page List steps, the temperature, the context size (n_ctx) and the Project Assistant chat values. This is the safe choice.
OffThe program leaves temperature, repeat penalty and context size alone, and every call uses the values saved in your own LLM workflow file in comfy_apis/llm. The long conversations (Story Bible, Image Prompts) then plan against that workflow’s context size, so a small n_ctx there makes them start new sessions more often.

The switch never changes what the program needs to work: the text it sends, the answer length limits, the session handling and the timeouts stay under the program’s control. With the switch off a step can fail or stop early if your workflow’s values do not suit it (for example a repeat penalty above 1 can cut a long shot list short); turn it back on to return to the tested values.

Tools sets an external image editor program (optional). Detection opens Detection Models…, where you can install small models that keep the narration box away from people and faces; the program works without them.

Note Your Grok key is stored on your computer in your user profile and is sent only to the Grok service when you use it. Do not share the key or your project files if they contain private text.

Image Editor

Image Editor works on a Working Folder: a normal folder of pictures. The edit history is kept inside that folder, so you can close the program and continue later.

Needs ComfyUI / an LLM Edit, Extend, Enhance, Prompt and Mask send work to ComfyUI and need matching workflows. Opening, viewing, importing and exporting pictures do not.
ButtonWhat it does
Open FolderOpen a Working Folder. Create one with the picker's New Folder button.
NewCreate a new image from a prompt with a text-to-image workflow (the files in comfy_apis/image_create).
ImportCopy images into the Working Folder. You can also drop images on the window.
EditEdit the current image with a workflow (the files in comfy_apis/image_edit) and a prompt.
AgainRun it again with the same workflow and prompt as the original.
MaskDraw a polygonal mask for inpainting.
PromptAnalyze the image and write a prompt for it. A small dialog asks which workflow from comfy_apis/caption to use.
ExtendExtend (outpaint) the picture beyond its edges.
EnhanceRestore faces and/or upscale. The dialog asks for the workflow (the files in comfy_apis/enhance that have Face Restore or Upscale nodes) and the options.
ExportSave a copy of this image to a file you choose.
Scale & ExportScale the picture up and export it. A dialog asks for the upscale workflow, then for the folder to save to.
DeleteDelete this image.

Extend: the Resize option

The Extend image dialog has a Workflow list: it shows the workflows in comfy_apis/enhance that contain a Pad Image for Outpainting node (flux_fill_outpaint.json is selected by default when you have it, and the dialog remembers your last choice). If the list is empty the dialog tells you to add one. In the same dialog, Resize before sending reduces the picture and the four extensions together before they go to ComfyUI, to save generation time. The line under the buttons always shows what the current choice will give.

OptionResult
Auto (default)The extended picture has the size of the original (rounded to a multiple of 8). The program works out how far to reduce the original picture and the extensions for that, for example “the original picture is reduced to 84%”. Available while Lock original aspect ratio is ticked (also the default); with the lock off the button is not offered and 100% is used.
25% / 50% / 75% / 100%Reduce the picture and the extensions to that share. The result is the extended canvas at that share, so it can be smaller than the original.

With a large extension Auto has to reduce the original picture a lot (the line turns orange below 40%) and the existing part loses detail; use a smaller extension, or run Enhance afterwards.

Working on several pictures

Click Select above the thumbnails, then click pictures (or hold Ctrl / Shift, or drag a box). A bar appears with Done, Clear (clear the selection, Esc), Edit (one workflow and prompt for all), Enhance (restore faces), Export (scale up and export to a folder) and delete. Deleting removes generated versions; source images are only removed from the list.

Prompt Lab

Prompt Lab is a notebook for prompts. Keep a list of them, rewrite them with an LLM and run them against a workflow to see what they make.

Needs ComfyUI / an LLM The chat needs an LLM (a local workflow in comfy_apis/llm or a Grok key). Running a prompt needs ComfyUI and an image workflow.

Prompts and their images are saved automatically in your user profile. Prompt Lab and the New button of Image Editor read the same text-to-image workflows (comfy_apis/image_create). Gallery Generator uses them too.

Batch Editor

Batch Editor applies one workflow and one prompt to a set of images.

Needs ComfyUI / an LLM Needs ComfyUI and a workflow that takes an image (for example an edit workflow).

Selecting pictures

Pictures can be added with Browse images or by dropping pictures or a folder on the window. Select them like in Image Editor and Gallery Generator: click a picture, Ctrl+click to add or remove one, Shift+click for a range, or drag a box over several. Ctrl+A selects all and Esc clears the selection; clicking empty space clears it too. Del (or the trash icon above the pictures) removes the selected pictures from the list; Clear list empties it.

Start Run processes only the selected pictures (the button shows Start Run (3 selected)); when nothing is selected it processes every picture in the list.

Gallery Generator

Gallery Generator draws pictures again and again from a list of prompts, until you stop it or the target is reached, and collects them in a gallery. The Working Folder holds the pictures and the gallery data together.

Needs ComfyUI / an LLM Needs ComfyUI and at least one image workflow.

Working with the gallery

  • Click a picture to select it; Ctrl or Shift adds more, and dragging a box selects a group.
  • Double-click to view large. In the viewer use ← and → to move, Esc to close and Del to delete.
  • Del deletes the selected pictures.

Where your data is

Your work is not stored in the program folder, so you can update or move the program without losing anything.

WhatWhere
Stories, last sessions, prompt lists, settings%APPDATA%\WorkflowPad (press Win+R, paste the path)
Your Grok key and shared credentials%APPDATA%\StoryGenerator
Temporary files, debug logs, optional detection models%LOCALAPPDATA%\WorkflowPad
PicturesThe folders you choose (Working Folder, Output Folder, export folders)
Your workflowscomfy_apis next to the program: image_create (text-to-image), image_edit (editing a picture), enhance, caption, llm

To back up, copy those folders. To start fresh, close the programs and delete the files you want to reset.

Troubleshooting

ProblemTry this
A workflow is missing from a listCheck that it was saved with Export (API), that it is in the right comfy_apis folder (image_create for drawing, image_edit for editing a picture) and that it is a .json file. Press the refresh button next to the list.
Nothing happens when I render or runMake sure ComfyUI is running and the address in Settings → Connection is right. Open the same workflow in ComfyUI and run it once there; if ComfyUI reports a missing model or node, fix that first.
Enter Grok API Key firstAdd your key in Settings → Grok API, or choose a local LLM under AI Model.
The AI answers in the wrong format or a step failsOpen AI Logs to see what was sent and received, and run the step again. You can also edit the text yourself in the project.
Pictures come out as coloured noiseOpen the workflow in ComfyUI and check the cfg of the sampler (KSampler). A value of 0 makes the sampler ignore the prompt; the examples in comfy_workflow use 1. Fix it there and export again.
ComfyUI says Invalid image file, or asks for a mask (Inpaint Mode)The chosen Inpaint/Img2Img workflow needs a mask or a second picture, which Story Generator does not send. Pick an edit workflow with one Load Image node and no mask, from comfy_apis/image_edit.
A manga page shows fewer panels than plannedPages of 2 to 5 panels use a fixed grid layout that the image model draws reliably; a page with more panels, or a model that merges panels, can still show fewer. Plan fewer panels per page if you need every panel.
A picture looks different from run to runTurn on Seed Lock in Story Generator, or use Run (not New Run) in Prompt Lab.
Windows warns about the programThe program is not code-signed. Choose More info → Run anyway if you downloaded it from the official release page.
